paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: PaLM 540B achieves 79.4% accuracy with multiple choice scoring and 69.7% accuracy with generative scoring on the Winogender benchmark in a 1-shot setting, and 84.7% accuracy with generative scoring in a 4-shot setting.

evidence.quote: For 1-shot settings, PaLM 540B performs at 79.4% accuracy with multiple choice scoring (GLaM 1-shot 71.7%) and 69.7% accuracy with stricter generative scoring. Particularly noteworthy is that PaLM 540B performance improves to 84.7% accuracy in a 4-shot setting, even when using the stricter generative scoring method.
